reason: The README describes a client plugin that adds grouped inventory and marketplace tabs to the web settings plugin section, with search, filtering, installed-status display, and installation-command copying; its primary user-facing purpose is navigation and plugin management UI.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设置中的插件区域添加分组清单和插件市场标签页，支持搜索筛选、已安装标记及安装命令复制。
summaries.en: Adds grouped inventory and marketplace tabs to DeepSeek Harness plugin settings, with search, filtering, installed-status indicators, and installation-command copying.

capabilities: Reads the host Cordis Loader plugin inventory
Displays a grouped plugin inventory with search and filtering
Displays an embedded plugin marketplace catalog
Copies plugin installation commands to the clipboard
